players.product: ASIC design house (Samsung Foundry DSP partner)

contracts.signal: DART supply-contract amendment filed 09-09-2026, a correction to the earlier disclosure: the custom ASIC development contract with Siemens Industry Software Inc. has its completion date EXTENDED from 2026-11-30 to 2027-02-28, and the disclosure-deferral deadline moves with it from 2026-11-30 to 2027-02-28; the stated reason is a partial change to the contract terms. The contract covers application-specific integrated circuit development, was originally signed 2023-08-31 with the amended order dated 2025-12-08, and is fulfilled through both in-house and outsourced production. The contract amount and payment terms remain undisclosed at the counterparty request for trade-secret protection, deferred to 2027-02-28; an advance payment applies and amounts are paid within 30 days of the payment conditions being met. Siemens Industry Software Inc. is a subsidiary of Siemens AG engaged in industrial software development and supply. AD Technology latest annual revenue, the 2024 consolidated figure used as the disclosure-threshold base, is KRW 106,545,463,919; the original 2023 contract fell below the mandatory-disclosure threshold on 2022 revenue and became disclosable only from the 2025-12-08 amendment.
